Description:
This class defines a IEEE1722DatagramAVTPDUCommonStreamHeaderFields object which
represents IEEE1722 defined AVTPDU common stream header fields.
Those header fields are shared between the following IEEE1722 defined AVTP stream data
subtypes: 61883_IIDC, AAF, RVF and TSCF.
